definitions.explanation: The coming to the surface of something latent: a gene producing its trait or protein, a drug taking effect, a quality or ability showing itself. Mainly a scientific and written word.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遺伝子|いでんし}→遺伝子：05031_idenshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{発現|はつげん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発現|はつげん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: It takes time for the drug's effect to appear.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦タンパク{質|しつ}→タンパク質：08817_tanpakushitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発現|はつげん}⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: This study examined how the amount of protein expression changes with temperature.

notes:
⟦{発|はつ}→〜発：04026_hatsu⟧ (emit, appear) + ⟦{現|げん}→現〜：03950_gen⟧ (show, become visible). Common in biology and medicine; outside science it appears in formal writing about abilities or traits coming out.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{遺伝子|いでんし}→遺伝子：05031_idenshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発現|はつげん}: gene expression
- ⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{発現|はつげん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: an effect appears
- {発現|はつげん}⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧: expression level
- ⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発現|はつげん}: onset of symptoms

WATCH OUT:
{発現|はつげん} sounds the same as ⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧ (remark, statement), which is far more common. In everyday speech, ⟦{現|あらわ}れる→現れる：01870_arawareru⟧ or ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ is the natural verb.
